title: Few-shot Prompting

body.text: giving 2–3 examples of the answer you want
before asking the real question — the AI mimics the format, tone, and structure of your examples.

example: "Turn names into emails: John Smith → john.s@company.com, Jane Doe → jane.d@company.com, so what about Michael Lee?"

title: When to use few-shot

body.text: Use it when you want a
— like a table format, a writing style, or a data-arrangement pattern that's harder to describe in words than to show by example.

example: "Write a news summary in this format: [Headline] | [one-line gist] | [impact]. Example: ..."
